# CANDIDATE: BOS_RETEST_WITH_RIBBON_ALIGNMENT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a bullish break of structure (BOS), a retest to the breakout level that aligns with the 21-period EMA offers a high-probability long. This edge exists because the retest to the breakout level with EMA alignment indicates the breakout is being validated by the short-term trend, reducing the likelihood of a false breakout in up-trending regimes.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When a bullish BOS occurs (price closes above a prior swing high and the prior swing low is higher than the previous swing low), wait for price to pull back to within 0.05×ATR of that breakout level and concurrently touch or cross above the 21-period EMA; enter long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Chart-stop at the prior swing low (structure invalidation), target at 2× risk or at the next swing high.  
**Regime filter:** Only consider entries after the first 40 minutes of trading (10:10 ET) and when VIX < 20 to reduce false breakouts in low-volatility environments.  
**Position sizing:** Follow risk-rules.md (min 3 contracts, scale per account equity).
